calibrated.why: today the price is 34.9x the first forecast year's operating EPS after business development (28.5x the 2027 consensus EPS, Alpha Vantage); that multiple belongs to EPS growing 43% in 2027, while the base path grows revenue 3-4% and operating EPS 1-2% a year in 2031-32 with the US tirzepatide patent ending in 2036. Held instead: 24x, about the lowest forward multiple the market paid for Lilly at any month-end of the last five years (23.1x, April 2026)

beta.reason_if_different: measured by the web lane on 105 weekly returns (deep/beta.py; window dates approximate), not the rule's 104 complete weeks; not recomputed

exit_pe.reason_if_different: the own median (38.7x on consensus-type EPS = 47.4x on the model's EPS after business development) was paid for EPS growing 46-105% a year; in the exit years the base grows revenue 3-4% and operating EPS 1-2%, and tirzepatide (57% of 2032 base revenue) loses its US compound patent in 2036 with generic filings made in 2026; direct peers trade at a median 17.6x forward today (NVO 12.4, AZN 16.6, MRK 17.6, ABBV 18.8, AMGN 19.2). 20x on the model's EPS is about 17x conventional. The literal rule is shown as a variant in valuation.md and does not change the verdict

notes.base_year: FY2026 at the guide midpoint 91,500 (release 29.10.2026: 91.0-92.0B; 9M 67,170 + implied Q4 23.8-24.8B) less ~2,000 of one-time revenue = 89,500. One-time: Q3 call (CFO): '2026 revenue benefited from approximately $2 billion of one-time items, primarily milestone payments and changes in estimates for rebates and discounts, that we do not expect to recur'; filings: Jardiance sales-based milestones 910 in 9M (none remain, 10-Q) + favorable prior-period rebate adjustments ~2% of US revenue (10-Q; ~0.8-1.1B). Consensus FY26 revenue 91.67B (Alpha Vantage, 25 analysts)
notes.drivers: revenue is the sum of seven parts (deep/drivers.md, deep/build_params.py): tirzepatide (Mounjaro + Zepbound), Foundayo (orforglipron), retatrutide, later incretins, new growth products (Jaypirca, Ebglyss, Kisunla, Omvoh, Inluriyo, later launches), the four products that lose exclusivity by 2031 (Trulicity, Jardiance, Taltz, Verzenio) and the rest
notes.margin: operating margin after stock compensation and after recurring business development: performance margin (gross margin - R&D - MS&A, non-GAAP; SBC is inside; guide 52.0-52.5% for 2026, 51.2% after removing the one-time revenue) less 0.7pt recurring special charges (2024 861, 2025 484, 9M26 1,285) less business development as a cost ($9.0-9.8B a year in the base = 8.5% of revenue falling to 6.5%; history: IPR&D purchases + acquisitions 5.0B in 2023, 4.3B in 2024, 3.7B in 2025, 18.2B in 9M 2026; Lilly itself keeps acquired IPR&D inside non-GAAP EPS). Amortization of acquired intangibles (~0.5B) is left out because the purchase cash is already counted. Base performance margin 53.0% in 2027 (consensus-implied ~54.6%), 53.5%, 53.0%, 53.0%, 52.0%, 51.0%: price erosion and the depreciation wave (depreciation 1.8% of revenue in 2026 to 3.6% in 2032) against MS&A leverage; the Jardiance collaboration share (near-100% margin) ends after 2028
notes.tax: 20% on income after business development (guide 19-20% non-GAAP for 2026 including nondeductible IPR&D; FY2025 19.8%; 9M 2026 21.0%)
notes.conv: FCF / NOPAT built from capex, depreciation and working capital: capex 12.5B (2027), 13.0, 12.0, 10.5, 9.5, 9.0 (TTM 11.0B; 9M 2026 8.4B; no capex guide: GAP; commitments: Houston $6.5B and Richmond $5B plants, +$4.5B Indiana, CIP 13.0B at Dec 2025; then fading to ~6% of revenue, the pre-surge share, which is not in the files read: judgement); depreciation from the capex vintages 2.2B rising to 5.4B (FY2025 1,314); working capital and other operating assets absorb 30% of added revenue (2026: about 8B on +26B: receivables +4.3B, inventory +4.5B, prepaid tax +2.2B in 9M, offset by rebates +6.8B)

notes.roic_terminal: 0.30: R&D and business development are already expensed in the margin, so terminal reinvestment (g / ROIC = 17% of NOPAT) covers only net capex and working capital; 2032 base reinvests 9% of NOPAT at 3% growth (implied 0.33)
notes.pe: exit multiple on next-year operating EPS AFTER business development. Locked rule = own long-run forward P/E median: 38.7x over Nov 2021-Oct 2026, 34.7x since 2023 (deep/multiple_history.py, hindsight series). NOT used, stated facts: (1) that median was paid for EPS growing +105% (2024), +86% (2025), +46% (2026), +43% (2027 consensus); in the exit year the base path grows operating EPS ~1-3% a year; (2) tirzepatide, ~57% of 2032 base revenue, loses US compound-patent protection in 2036 (10-K) and generic ANDAs were filed in 2026 (10-Q Note 9); (3) direct peers today: NVO 12.4x, AZN 16.6x, MRK 17.6x, ABBV 18.8x, AMGN 19.2x forward (stockanalysis.com statistics pages, 2026-11-15), median 17.6x. Base 20x on after-BD operating EPS (~17x on a conventional EPS before future IPR&D = the peer median); bull 28x (~23x conventional = the bottom of Lilly's own five-year range); bear 14x (~12x conventional = Novo Nordisk today). The locked-rule multiple is shown as a variant line in valuation.md
notes.patent_cliff: the model's fade years (2033-2041) grow NOPAT from the 2032 rate up to rf and cannot show the 2036 US / 2037 EU tirzepatide loss of exclusivity. It is put in as a charge in 2032 (index 5) = present value at 2032 of losing 15% (base), 8% (bull), 20% (bear) of the model's own after-tax path from 2038 on, phased over 2036-2038 (deep/build_params.py cliff_charge). The charge enters the DCF; the exit-multiple method carries the cliff in the multiple
notes.bear: company-specific: net price falls faster than volume grows (price -13% to -15% a year in 2026 per releases; Medicare coverage at government prices; more entrants: Novo oral and CagriSema, Pfizer monthly from 2028), tirzepatide flat at 66-69B then down to 59B; successors slower; performance margin 50% falling to 44%; business development stays at 9B; charges after tax: 4,000 in 2028 for inventory (18.2B, +32% in 9M) and take-or-pay supply commitments (up to ~10B, 10-K), 2,000 in 2029 for litigation (product-liability MDLs, pricing, 340B; self-insured). A harsher tail (tirzepatide down to 51B by 2032, margin to 41%) is worth about $250 and is not in the table
notes.bull: the guidance-beat record: first revenue guide beaten by +11% (2023), +9.7% (2024), +10.5% (2025) and the 2026 guide raised +12% in three steps (releases); bull 2027 revenue 111.5B = +4.7% above consensus 106.5B (analyst high 114.3B); incretin franchise 139B in 2030; performance margin to 57%
notes.probabilities: subjective judgement, not engine odds: bear 25%, base 50%, bull 25%
